title: Professional Certificate Course in Understanding Intercultural Communication and Perspectives
description: Unravel the intricacies of intercultural communication, navigate diverse perspectives, and empower yourself to connect meaningfully across borders.
longDescription: Defining and Importance of intercultural communication. Identify and apply different frameworks used in intercultural communication analysis. Evaluate and implement appropriate pedagogies to enhance intercultural communication skills. Explain the concept of Pragmatic Awareness. Describe Cultural Relativity Theory and distinguish between its types. Analyse the impact of Power distance and Interaction on intercultural communication dynamics. Compare and contrast different paradigms used to study intercultural communication. Understand the concept and principles of the Intercultural Communicative Language Teaching (ICLT) model. Demonstrate an understanding of negotiation and persuasion techniques and their foundations in cross-cultural contexts. Dive into the fascinating world of intercultural communication. Understand its significance, analyze diverse frameworks, explore teaching methods, and unravel key concepts like pragmatic awareness, cultural relativity, and power dynamics. Master negotiation and persuasion strategies in cross-cultural contexts, and discover the ICLT model for effective language teaching. After the successful completion of the course, you will be able to learn about the following:
courseDetails: This course covers defining intercultural communication, applying analysis frameworks, enhancing skills through pedagogies, exploring Pragmatic Awareness, Cultural Relativity Theory, power dynamics, interaction impact, paradigms, and the Intercultural Communicative Language Teaching (ICLT) model. Additionally, understand negotiation and persuasion techniques in cross-cultural contexts.
